## Appearance

Margaret possesses pale, soft brown hair and a little, sweet, white face with an elfin quality. She is also noted for having long, slender fingers.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015)_

## History

Fifty years before the events at [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), Margaret fell asleep in her father's dory and drifted out to sea, becoming Captain Jim's long-lost love. Decades later, Captain Jim shared her tragic story with [Anne](../character/anne.md), asking her to remember Margaret and pass her tale on so she would not be forgotten. Her story was subsequently incorporated alongside Captain Jim's life story into a book written by [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P46](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), +129 more_

### [Baxter](../character/baxter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/baxter--margaret.md)

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P18](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0018)</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/margaret--uncle-jim.md)

[Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), also known as Captain Jim, was Margaret's long-lost former love. Before his passing, he kept her memory alive by sharing the tragic story of their romance with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and entrusting her to pass the tale down to future generations. His life story and his enduring love for Margaret were ultimately immortalized in a manuscript written by [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).

- Romantically involved with — long-lost former love  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P35](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0035)</sub>
